topic: Fast-cut Lamine Yamal skills and goals edit to the track 'Y Que Fue?' by Don Miguelo
hook: Man in red top with fans at stadium exit, then tight close-up of Yamal's face; NB logo top-right
subtitle_style: none; small 'NB' logo watermark top-right, subscribe/like button pop-ups mid video
reaction_overlays: colour flashes, neon glow, zoom/blur pops, subscribe/like overlay at 22-26 s
transition_summary: Beat-synced rapid cuts with flashes, whip/zoom, glow, slow-mo; detected cuts cluster (up to ~10 cuts in a few seconds), ~5-8 cuts per 10 s
audio_note: Don Miguelo track 'Y Que Fue?' with spoken hook lyrics ('Mambo... Chapa... And what happened?')

reuse_segments.what: Yamal clips from UCL/La Liga/Supercopa broadcast and tunnel/phone footage
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: needs licensed footage; track also copyrighted (Don Miguelo) - replace with licensed music
